summary: WisdomTree filed an 8-K reporting privately negotiated repurchases of $51.9M aggregate principal of its 3.25% Convertible Senior Notes due 2029 for ~$87.3M cash (a premium over par reflecting the conversion value). The transactions, expected to close June 1, 2026, will leave $18.1M of the Notes outstanding. No tender offer is used; these are issuer-initiated repurchases to reduce leverage/conversion overhang, not a formal debt tender. The filing lacks board recommendation or advisor roles. Watch for the closing condition and potential impact on diluted share count; the premium indicates embedded conversion economics.
